reviewer: Pickle: 한국소비자원 의류관리기 3종 시험의 구김등급·작동시간·탈취살균·건조시간·제습량·소음·소비전력·개선권고 수치, 쿠팡 2종 판매 조건
method: Reviewed the draft against the 21 recorded facts and 10 citations on 2026-11-21. Primary source: the KCA consumer24 comparison page for clothing care machines (infoId=A1081416, published 2026-09-16) and its attachment PDFs, opened directly. Attachment 1 gives the selection basis (all three brands, 500 consumers surveyed in January 2026, the latest maximum-capacity model per brand with the Coway unit at three garments) and the February to March 2026 online prices of 2,399,000 won for Samsung DF90H24R4D, 2,360,000 won for LG SC5MSR82S and 2,250,000 won for Coway FAD-02S, plus the test methods (KS K 0891, KS C IEC 60704-1, KC 60335-1). Attachment 2 gives the per-product values I used: wrinkle grades of 2.5 to 3.0 for the standard styling course with the 3.4 kilogram and 20 minute wrinkle setup on 65 percent polyester and 35 percent cotton shirts, run times of 37, 31 and 45 minutes (14 minute spread), the specialized courses reaching 4.0 or better (Samsung wrinkle-focused 25 minutes, LG hand steamer after a 3 minute warm-up and 30 seconds per shirt), 99 percent or more deodorization and sterilization across four strains with 90 percent or more allergen protein reduction, dryness of 102 percent for all three from an initial moisture content of about 43 percent, maximum-capacity drying times of 1 hour 7 minutes, 1 hour 10 minutes and 1 hour 30 minutes (23 minute spread) and single-shirt times of 39, 54 and 90 minutes with 28 and 16 minute savings, dehumidification of 937, 626 and 567 millilitres over two hours at about 27 degrees and 60 percent humidity with the Samsung door open and the others closed, noise of 44 decibels or lower for Coway and 48 or lower for the other two with the 3 decibel doubling note and the dehumidifier range of 43 to 54 and 49 to 57 decibels, standard-course power of 397, 342 and 332 watt-hours, drying power of 521, 686 and 441 watt-hours at full capacity and 260, 516 and 419 for one shirt, annual electricity of 9,100, 7,900 and 7,600 won at 144 uses and 160 won per kilowatt-hour, CO2 of 169, 145 and 141 grams averaging 152, the air purifying standard area of 16.6 square metres for Coway (CADR divided by 7.7), and the three improvement recommendations with supplier replies (LG ThinQ update and 1544-7777, Samsung hinge fix on 9 July 2026 and door-closed alert on 7 August 2026 with 1588-3366, Coway design change for future models). The government briefing page supplies the capacity caveat that Coway has no five-garment model and the door-open condition applies only to the dehumidifying test. My own arithmetic is recorded in the research file: 39,000 and 149,000 won test-price gaps, the Coupang price differences of 300,000 won (12.5 percent), 527,290 won (22.3 percent) and 11,000 won (0.5 percent), per-use electricity of 52.8, 54.9 and 63.2 won, five-year electricity of 38,000, 39,500 and 45,500 won, per-garment power of 104.2, 137.2 and 147.0 watt-hours with 2.5, 3.8 and 2.9 multiples for a single shirt, dehumidification ratios of 1.50 and 1.65, the 2.5-fold sound energy for a 4 decibel gap, 55.2 and 7.2 hours of annual drying time, 2.77 uses per week, and single-load drying costs of 41.6, 67.0 and 82.6 won per shirt and 70.6 to 109.8 won per full load. Products: both Coupang pages were opened in the browser on 2026-11-21 and showed Samsung at 2,099,000 won from 2,500,000 won (16 percent, free shipping, delivery schedule by phone or text in three to five days, seller JL Commerce with Samsung direct delivery, 20,000 won round-trip return fee, no reviews on this listing) and the LG steamer set at 1,832,710 won from 2,440,000 won with a Wow coupon and Hana card condition, free shipping and installation, installation date selectable from 23 November to 22 December, 136 reviews at 5.0, seller Coupang, KC HM07125-23174P and dimensions 600 by 1965 by 620 millimetres. Affiliate deep links were built from each pageKey, itemId and vendorItemId and both landed on the matching product page. Gate score 97/100 with all 192 numbers backed by the research file.
